spans.s: --the wrestling place where separate seats were arranged for judges, nobles, women, cowherds, etc. Women of the palace and the city attended such matches; these women recalled कृष्ण's former exploits. Vi. V. २०. २३-29, ४३, ४५-7. [page३-044+ २३]
(II)--a son of Riveyu, his wife was सरस्वती. वा. ९९. १२८, १२९.

(I)--a son of सङ्कृति: attained permanent fame. He performed a sacrifice when he gave up all he had and suffered with his family having nothing to eat for fortyeight days. When he had something to eat, there came a Brahmana guest and a वृषल, and another guest with dogs around him; they all shared it. When he had some- thing to drink, there came a Pulkasa and asked for the drink and got it. To such a high soul, the gods showed दर्शन्. All his followers became Yogins, himself having realised the योगमाया of विष्णु.
